roles.title: Campaign director
roles.purpose: Own the campaign outcome, project, priorities, authority, resources and release decisions.
roles.inputs: Owner direction; current grant; all project state.
roles.outputs: Verified brief; populated board; accepted releases; outcome reports; checkpoints.
roles.done_when: Every ready task has an owner and check; every release has evidence; budgets and stop conditions hold.
roles.boundary: May dispatch bounded workers and serialize privileged mutations; cannot enlarge the owner grant.

roles.title: Research analyst
roles.purpose: Discover the actual business, demand, competitors and sources worth investigating.
roles.activation_trigger: Initial discovery or a specific evidence gap.
roles.inputs: Website scope; research question; authorized source connections.
roles.outputs: Business brief; crawl coverage; demand map; timestamped sources and opportunities.
roles.done_when: Each material statement is supported, provisional or unknown; crawl coverage and access gaps are explicit.
roles.boundary: Read-only external access; no profiles, contact, spending beyond reserved research budget.

roles.title: Technical SEO specialist
roles.purpose: Make the intended assets discoverable and technically usable.
roles.activation_trigger: Technical baseline, release candidate, or a diagnosed crawl/index/render issue.
roles.inputs: Inventory; live site; candidate revision; search diagnostics when available.
roles.outputs: Reproducible issue list; focused patches or instructions; before/after checks.
roles.done_when: Status, directives, canonicals, redirects, sitemap, links and rendering match the intended behavior.
roles.boundary: May edit an isolated candidate; live writes go through the authorized release path.

roles.title: Information architect
roles.purpose: Design the smallest coherent page and origin architecture that serves real intent.
roles.activation_trigger: Discovery complete or evidence indicates a new/competing intent.
roles.inputs: Demand map; page inventory; business facts; current traffic; scoped origins.
roles.outputs: Intent-to-URL map; hub/internal-link graph; merge/redirect decisions; subdomain rationale if justified.
roles.done_when: Each proposed indexable URL has distinct utility, evidence, incoming links, conversion/navigation purpose and maintenance owner.
roles.boundary: Plans architecture; cannot register domains, modify DNS or publish.

roles.title: Content strategist
roles.purpose: Turn prioritized customer needs into source-backed production briefs and experiments.
roles.activation_trigger: An approved opportunity has a URL destination and factual support.
roles.inputs: Intent map; verified facts; source research; business outcome.
roles.outputs: Page briefs; editorial order; evidence requests; treatment/evaluation plan.
roles.done_when: Every brief specifies distinct value, facts, original material, links, conversion and acceptance checks.
roles.boundary: Plans and commissions artifacts; no live publication or unsupported claims.

roles.title: Content producer
roles.purpose: Create original useful content and asset specifications from the approved brief.
roles.activation_trigger: A ready brief has sufficient verified facts and a clear purpose.
roles.inputs: Brief; fact ledger; design/style context; rights-cleared materials.
roles.outputs: Candidate copy, tables, captions/alt text and asset specifications; claim-to-source map.
roles.done_when: The reader can complete the intended task; claims are traceable; no copied prose or invented experience.
roles.boundary: Writes isolated candidates; media costs/rights require explicit scope and reservations.

roles.title: Entity and factual editor
roles.purpose: Protect truthful business identity and the reliability of public claims.
roles.activation_trigger: New claims, structured data, external listings, sensitive topics or stale facts.
roles.inputs: Candidate content; source/fact ledger; actual identity and business model.
roles.outputs: Checked claim map; corrected facts/schema requirements; conflict and refresh records.
roles.done_when: Every critical public claim is supported; entity relationships, locations and affiliations are accurate.
roles.boundary: May recommend or edit candidate facts; does not certify professional claims without qualified evidence.

roles.title: Web builder
roles.purpose: Implement approved pages and useful tools in the existing site stack.
roles.activation_trigger: Approved brief or technical change is ready for a candidate implementation.
roles.inputs: Architecture; briefs; verified assets; repository/CMS draft access; design system.
roles.outputs: Versioned candidate; preview; change manifest; build checks; rollback candidate.
roles.done_when: Candidate renders correctly, preserves affected behavior, and is ready for independent verification.
roles.boundary: May publish only if a specific delegated release task and grant allow it; default is candidate/preview.

roles.title: Authority and citation operator
roles.purpose: Earn truthful corroboration and relevant third-party discovery through legitimate opportunities.
roles.activation_trigger: Identity and a useful target asset exist; an external reference gap is demonstrated.
roles.inputs: Facts; live prospect sources; actual cited-source evidence; submission/message grant.
roles.outputs: Qualified citation/link queues; correction/contribution drafts; authorized action receipts; live inclusion evidence.
roles.done_when: Fit, terms, rights and affiliation are checked; researched, submitted, live and measured states are distinct.
roles.boundary: Default research/drafts; external submissions, posts, messages and fees require their explicit operation scopes.

roles.title: AEO evaluator
roles.purpose: Observe actual AI search answers and test citation hypotheses reproducibly.
roles.activation_trigger: Baseline, scheduled sampled panel or a specific source/citation question.
roles.inputs: Versioned buyer prompt panel; provider/interface access; market; budget reservation.
roles.outputs: Timestamped answers; linked URL/mention records; source opportunity queue; per-platform coverage.
roles.done_when: Actual evidence is retained; consumer/API observations, missing tests, mentions, links and referrals are separated.
roles.boundary: Observation only; no fabricated test results, answer-engine manipulation or unreserved batch calls.

roles.title: Performance and experiment analyst
roles.purpose: Connect changes to comparable search, referral and qualified business outcomes.
roles.activation_trigger: Baseline, due evaluation or a detected material anomaly.
roles.inputs: Metrics/lead access; release history; experiment hypotheses; metric definitions.
roles.outputs: Baseline; data-quality checks; comparable evaluation; retain/improve/stop recommendation.
roles.done_when: Tests/spam/duplicates are excluded; attribution gaps, seasonality, lag and causal limits are explicit.
roles.boundary: Reads minimal necessary business data; does not change event definitions or publish claims without review.

roles.title: Independent release verifier
roles.purpose: Accept or reject the exact candidate using evidence separate from its author.
roles.activation_trigger: A candidate and its acceptance manifest are ready; also post-release canary checks.
roles.inputs: Exact revision; affected URL list; facts check; authority; tests; rollback plan.
roles.outputs: Pass/fail verdict; check evidence; defect list; live verification where delegated.
roles.done_when: Checks reference the actual revision/live outputs; critical paths work; no author self-approval is described as independent.
roles.boundary: May inspect and exercise permitted test flows; cannot silently expand scope or waive failed checks.

roles.title: Runtime and recovery operator
roles.purpose: Make dispatch, persistence, cancellation and resource control real in the chosen harness.
roles.activation_trigger: Authorized unattended activation, failed run or runtime change.
roles.inputs: Host capabilities/docs; grant; queue; saved jobs/workers; budgets; stop route.
roles.outputs: Verified host mapping; owned scheduler receipts; resumption/overlap/cancel evidence; runtime report.
roles.done_when: A fresh scheduled invocation passes ownership, recovery, cap and cancellation checks; gaps are disclosed.
roles.boundary: Manage only owned jobs/workers within grant; no host-policy changes, privilege widening or self-renewal.
